metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: Fugue VII in E-flat major (a 8): Fuga a due cori
metadata.instrument: Two four-voice choirs (Coro I left, Coro II right)

markers.label: Coro II: the mirror exposition (bass first)
Antiphony by the bar: heads round a circle of fifths
Antiphony by the bar, overlapping: entries a bar apart
Disagreement: Coro I in B-flat, Coro II in A-flat
Reconciliation: A-flat over B-flat = the home dominant
The joke: augmentation interrupted by diminution
Summit: stretto a 8, all voices enter half a bar apart
Coda: "Wachet auf" in the tenor; the augmentation finished
Final cadence: A-flat over B-flat, then E-flat

subject_entries.label: Coro II inversus (mirror of the answer: A-flat)
Coro II inversus (mirror of the answer: A-flat)
stretto a 8: Coro II inversus (on F)
Coro II: the echo, upside down
